qualifier: serine, sulfur and aromatic amino acids with cofactors
name: Serine, sulfur and aromatic amino acid and cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and breakdown of serine/glycine/threonine, sulfur (cysteine, transsulfuration, sulfide) and aromatic (Phe/Tyr, BH4) amino acids plus B6 and MoCo cofactors, unlike confusables centred on glycine conjugation, organic acids, glutamate/glutamine or alanine.

qualifier: hexosamine and sialic acid with N-glycan processing
name: Hexosamine and sialic acid metabolism with N-glycan processing
rationale: Members concern UDP-GlcNAc, mannose and sialic acid synthesis/catabolism and N-glycan trimming with their CDG/myasthenic defects, distinguishing them from confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI anchors, fucose and O-glycan termination.

name: Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are MPS III (Sanfilippo A-D) or MPS IV (Morquio A/B) disorders, whereas confusables hold Hurler, Hunter, Maroteaux-Lamy, Sly and Natowicz types or generic GAG degradation.

name: Oncogenic FGFR fusion and amplification signaling
rationale: Every member is signaling by amplified or fused FGFR1-3 in cancer, while confusables concern EGFR/ERBB2, ALK, KIT/PDGFR or LTK mutants.

name: Regulation of meiotic metaphase-to-anaphase transition
rationale: Members are the meiotic metaphase/anaphase transition and its negative regulation (chromosome separation, phase transition), unlike confusables on mitotic spindle checkpoint, meiosis I spindle positioning or meiotic cohesion and segregation.

core: Damaged base excision by DNA glycosylases
name: Damaged base removal by DNA glycosylases and their defects
rationale: Members are lesion recognition, base cleavage and APEX1 handover by DNA glycosylases plus defective OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1/NEIL variants, whereas confusables cover downstream AP-site resolution, gap filling and strand-break repair.

qualifier: sprouting inhibition and adherens junction regulation
name: Endothelial VEGFR2/Tie2 signaling, sprouting inhibition and adherens junctions
rationale: Members combine VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling with negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and cadherin/adherens-junction control, distinguishing them from confusables on endothelial differentiation or pro-angiogenic regulation.

name: Rho/Rnd GTPase signaling downstream of G12/13 and Sema4D
rationale: Members are G alpha 12/13 and Sema4D inputs to Rho, Rnd1-3 cycles and ROCK/PAK effectors, unlike confusables on Rac/Cdc42 cycles or Sema3A-plexin axon repulsion.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransporter and Na+/H+ exchanger defects
name: Cation-chloride cotransporter and Na+/H+ exchanger transport defects
rationale: Members are cation-chloride cotransporters, sodium/proton exchangers and potassium channels with their Gitelman, Bartter and neurodevelopmental defects, unlike confusables on bicarbonate/SLC26 anion exchange, osmotic responses or renal sodium transport.

name: Regulation of viral entry, replication and release
rationale: Members regulate viral entry, genome replication, protein levels and release by host or virus, without the interferon/ISG15 programmes or receptor-mediated virion endocytosis of the confusables.

name: Semaphorin 3A and netrin repulsive axon guidance
rationale: Members are axon guidance and extension driven by Sema3A-plexin (CRMPs, PAK, integrin) and netrin repulsion, distinguishing them from ephrin/L1/DCC, collateral sprouting and Sema4D/Rnd confusables.

name: COPI Golgi traffic and TGN-endosome-lysosome sorting
rationale: Members are COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic plus TGN/endosome/lysosome sorting and secretion, unlike confusables on COPII ER export, Golgi structural organization or endocytic recycling.

name: Core BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER circadian clock loop
rationale: Members describe the BMAL1:CLOCK activation and CRY:PER repression cycle with entrainment and rhythm output, unlike confusables on MECP2/NPAS4 neuronal transcription or ROR/REV-ERB/PPAR metabolic regulation.

name: Proton-coupled di- and oligopeptide transport
rationale: All members are proton/oligopeptide cotransport of di- and oligopeptides, distinct from confusables on amino acid transporters and NOD-mediated muramyl dipeptide sensing.

name: snRNA gene transcription and spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members are Pol II and Pol III (type 3 promoter) snRNA transcription, snRNA cap hypermethylation and spliceosome assembly and splicing, unlike confusables on Pol III tRNA transcription, histone mRNA processing or exosome RNA decay.

name: Netrin-dependent axon guidance and axon extension control
rationale: Members are netrin signaling and repulsion, chemorepulsion and regulation of axon extension in monoaminergic and sensory neurons, lacking the semaphorin-plexin and collateral sprouting members of the confusables.

name: GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake, adiponectin and insulin sensitization
rationale: Members regulate GLUT4 translocation and glucose import, adiponectin signaling, insulin response and muscle activity/PGC-1alpha, unlike confusables on insulin secretion, fatty acid uptake, adipogenesis or glucagon signaling.

qualifier: with peroxisome biogenesis and protein import
name: Peroxisome biogenesis and peroxisomal lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are peroxisomal protein import and fission plus very-long-chain, branched and medium-chain fatty acid oxidation, elongation and plasmalogen synthesis, unlike confusables on cholesterol or bile acid synthesis.

name: Desmosomal and hemidesmosomal adhesion, including cardiomyocyte junctions
rationale: Members are intermediate filament-anchored desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly and cell-cell adhesion including cardiomyocyte coupling, unlike confusables on cornification/skin barrier or adherens junctions and apical polarity.

qualifier: monocyte and dendritic cell surface identity
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface identity signatures
rationale: Members are transcriptional and surface signatures of monocytes, resting dendritic cells and neutrophils, unlike confusables on activated DC antigen presentation or monocyte activation.

name: ISG15-mediated interferon-stimulated antiviral restriction
rationale: Members are ISG15 conjugation and IFN-alpha-induced host restriction of viral invasion and release, distinguished from confusables on broad type I IFN signatures, OAS/PKR responses or ubiquitin chain formation.

name: Regulation of amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: All members regulate amyloid fibril formation or amyloid-beta clearance, without the microglial activation and differentiation members of the confusables.

name: Factor VIII and IX defects in intrinsic coagulation
rationale: Members are the intrinsic coagulation pathway and defective F8/F9 variants (hemophilia A/B), unlike confusables on fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, VWF or factor XII defects.

qualifier: glial activation, survival and amyloid pathology
name: Glial activation, survival and amyloid pathology regulation
rationale: Members regulate microglial/astrocyte activation, glial proliferation and apoptosis together with amyloid-beta formation, tangles and nerve regeneration, while confusables centre on amyloid clearance or APP synthesis.

name: Nephron patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
rationale: Members are nephron proximal-distal patterning and comma- and S-shaped body and tubule morphogenesis, unlike confusables on nephric duct, mesenchymal-epithelial transition, renal vesicle or ureteric bud formation.
